name: Errin Rowan
story: Errin Rowan appears in the 2017 New Zealand Esri User Conference programme as an Eagle Technology presenter. Rowan co-presented the two-part ArcGIS Pro “What’s New” session with Lauren McArtney, placing her in the technical training and product-translation work through which local users learned new desktop GIS capabilities.
